decision: The strict-interior construction closes both identified safety gaps and retains substantial source-adaptive mean value, but AY3 P95 is 0.3719% worse than the global LUT. The frozen all-population tail gate fails and BJ2 closes without further LUT-envelope, basis, predictor or threshold iteration.
forbidden_rescue: do not relax or round the AY3 P95 gate
do not tune headroom, safety factor, coefficient range, grid, rank, regularization, descriptor, alpha, target or AO6
do not acquire a new confirmation population or run visual review
do not treat the two passing populations as confirmation
allowed_next: leave the adaptive neutral-base LUT family closed and return to a distinct evidence-backed film-look or physical-image-formation algorithm leaf
claim_ceiling: negative development decision for one strict-interior adaptive LUT with strong mean and safety evidence but failed fresh-tail generalization
